message.content:
**Uno – Basic Rules** | Item | Description | |------|-------------| | **Deck** | 108 cards: 4 colors (Red, Yellow, Green, Blue) × 25 cards each (one 0, two 1‑9, two Skip, two Reverse, two Draw Two) + 4 Wild + 4 Wild Draw Four. | | **Goal** | Be the first player to score 500 points (or a pre‑agreed total). Points are tallied after each round. | | **Setup** | • Shuffle the deck.
• Deal 7 cards to each player.
• Place the remaining cards face down as the draw pile.
• Flip the top card of the draw pile to start the discard pile. If it’s an action card, apply its effect immediately. | | **Turn Order** | Players take turns clockwise (unless a Reverse card changes direction). | | **Playing a Card** | On your turn you may play one card that matches either the color or the value of the top discard.
• **Number cards** match by number or color.
• **Action cards** (Skip, Reverse, Draw Two) match by color or by being the same action.
• **Wild** cards can be played on any card and let you choose the next color.
• **Wild Draw Four** can only be played if you have no other playable card; you choose the next color. | | **Drawing** | If you cannot play a card, draw one from the draw pile. If that card is playable, you may play it immediately; otherwise the turn ends. | | **UNO Call** | When you have one card left, you must say “UNO” before the next player takes their turn. Failure to do so results in a penalty: draw two cards. | | **Winning a Round** | The round ends when a player discards all their cards. That player scores points equal to the sum of the values of all cards remaining in opponents’ hands:
• Number cards = face value.
• Skip, Reverse, Draw Two = 20 points each.
• Wild, Wild Draw Four = 50 points each. | | **Scoring** | Add the round score to the winner’s total. The first player to reach the target score (usually 500) wins the game. | **Optional Variations** | Variation | Effect | |-----------|--------| | **Stacking** | Allow players to stack Draw Two or Wild Draw Four cards, forcing the next player to draw the cumulative total unless they can counter. | | **Seven-O** | Playing a 7 lets you swap hands with another player; playing a 0 forces everyone to pass their hand in the current direction. | | **Jump-In** | If you have an exact duplicate of the top discard, you may play it immediately, even out of turn. | | **Custom Decks** | Use themed decks (e.g., Uno Attack) or add extra action cards for more chaos. | **Common Misconceptions** | Misconception | Clarification | |---------------|---------------| | “Wild Draw Four can be played anytime.” | It can only be played if you have no other legal card. | | “You can play a Wild card on a Wild card.” | Yes, but you must declare the new color. | | “The first player must always draw a card.” | Only if they cannot play a card from their initial hand. | **Strategy Tips** | Tip | Why it helps | |-----|--------------| | Keep a balanced hand (mix of colors and numbers). | Increases flexibility to match future cards. | | Save Wild cards for when you’re stuck or to change the color to your advantage. | Gives you control over the next play. | | Pay attention to opponents’ colors and numbers. | Helps anticipate when they’ll be forced to draw. | Enjoy your game!
